How it works

Ordering from China, 
step by step 

Six steps from your first message to goods at your door. Here is what we do at each step, and the few things we need from you.

We doYou do
  1. 1

    Inquiry

    Send us your product, quantity, target price and destination.

    We do

    Reply within 24 hours

    You do

    Send product details

  2. 2

    Sourcing

    We shortlist suitable factories across China and compare quotes.

    We do

    Shortlist & compare factories

    You do

    Choose a factory

  3. 3

    Samples

    Samples are collected and checked, then sent for your approval.

    We do

    Collect & check samples

    You do

    Approve the sample

  4. 4

    Production

    We follow production with the factory and keep you updated.

    We do

    Track production

    You do

    Pay the deposit

  5. 5

    Inspection

    Goods are inspected against your specs before the balance is paid.

    We do

    Inspect & send photo report

    You do

    Review, then pay balance

  6. 6

    Shipping

    Freight is booked by sea, air or rail to your destination.

    We do

    Book freight & share tracking

    You do

    Receive your goods

What we do

From factory floor 
to your port 

We find the right factories in China, check them and their goods, and get your order shipped. Use one service or all of them.

/01

Product Sourcing

Tell us what you need. We find suitable manufacturers across China and compare quotes for your product, budget and volume.

Supplier searchQuotesSamples
Learn more
/02

Factory Vetting

Before you commit, we visit and check factories: production capacity, past work, and whether they can deliver what they promise.

Factory visitsBackground checks
Learn more
/03

Quality Inspection

Goods are checked against your specifications before they leave the factory, with a photo report so problems are caught early.

Pre-shipmentPhoto reports
Learn more
/04

Order Follow-up

We keep in touch with the factory through production, in Chinese and English, and keep you updated on progress and timelines.

Production trackingBilingual
Learn more
/05

Shipping Coordination

We arrange sea, air or rail freight with partner forwarders and keep the paperwork moving, from the factory door to your port.

SeaAirRail
Learn more
/06

Samples & Consolidation

We collect samples for your approval and combine goods from several suppliers into one shipment to save on freight.

Sample handlingMulti-supplier
Learn more
Products & industries

What we 
source for you 

These are the categories we source most. Need something else? Send us the details and we'll tell you honestly whether we can help.

Hotel & Café Supplies

For hotels, restaurants and cafés.

  • Tableware & glassware
  • Linens & towels
  • Guest amenities
  • Café equipment

Packaging

Branded and plain packaging at scale.

  • Boxes & cartons
  • Paper & poly bags
  • Labels & stickers
  • Printed packaging

Textiles & Apparel

Fabrics, garments and home textiles.

  • Fabrics
  • Uniforms & workwear
  • Garments
  • Home textiles

Home & Kitchen Goods

Everyday household products.

  • Cookware
  • Storage & organisers
  • Kitchen tools
  • Small household items

Images are illustrative of each category.

Quality control

Checked before 
you pay the balance 

Most problems with China orders are found too late. We check the factory before you order and the goods before they ship.

Factory audits

Before you order, we visit the factory and check registration, production lines, capacity and past work.

01

Pre-shipment inspection

Before goods leave, we check them against your approved sample: quantity, workmanship, function, packaging and labels.

02

Photo & video reports

You receive photos and video of what we found, so you can approve or ask for fixes before paying the balance.

03
Shipping & logistics

Sea, air or rail, 
door to port 

We arrange freight with partner forwarders and quote it with your order. Transit times below are typical ranges and vary by route and season.

approx. 15–45 days

Sea freight

Best value for large or heavy orders. Full container (FCL) or shared container (LCL).

approx. 3–10 days

Air freight

For samples, urgent or high-value goods. Faster, priced by weight.

approx. 15–25 days to Europe

Rail freight

China–Europe and Central Asia rail: faster than sea, cheaper than air.

Incoterms we quote on

Who pays for what

FOB · Free On Board

The factory delivers goods onto the ship at the Chinese port. You arrange and pay for the sea freight and everything after.

Who we are

Based in China. 
Working for you. 

Sino Vorex is a sourcing and export partner for buyers around the world, working with manufacturers across China.

We find factories, check them and their goods, follow production and arrange shipping, so you can buy from China with fewer surprises. Our team works in Chinese and English, close to the factories.

Fees & payment

Clear fees, 
agreed upfront 

We charge a commission on the order value. The rate depends on the product and order size and is confirmed in writing in your quote before any work starts.

Accepted payment
  • T/T (bank transfer)
  • Terms agreed per order
Deposits

Factories usually ask for a deposit before production and the balance before shipment. We tell you the exact terms for each factory in your quote, and recommend paying the balance only after inspection.

Frequently asked

  • MOQs are set by each factory and depend on the product. We include the MOQ in every quote, and where possible look for factories that accept smaller first orders.

Get in touch

Tell us what 
you want to source 

Send your product details and we'll reply within 24 hours with next steps and the information we need for a quote.
